itemized.notes: 4-page handwritten filing (Steven L. DeBry, County Council, September 15 2010 interim; schedules hand-dated 9-14-10). The address column has been REDACTED on the contributions page - it is blanked with only stray character fragments surviving at its right edge - so donor_city/donor_state are blank on every row and marked 'redacted'. IN-KIND: one contribution (Reagan Signs, $1540.00, 8-30-10) has 'in kind' written under the amount, and the same item appears on Schedule B as an outdoor-advertising expenditure of $1,540.00 - the same economic event on both sides by the filer's design, and both page subtotals require it. THE IMPORTANT PROPERTY OF THIS FILING is that the SUBTOTAL and TOTAL rows mean different things: subtotal = this reporting period (and reconciles to the Summary Page), total = cycle to date ($13,143.46 contributions / $7,006.47 expenditures). Do not read either schedule TOTAL as a page sum.
